control_limits.oracle: Establishes that B's fix-branch pair-to-index map equals A's for all 2646 g variables under --squares 3 --heavy --sym; --fix-json is append-only (base prefix identical in all 14 designs); B base hash 42a5f304... equals B_C321/B_C411 metadata; design populations equal the bit populations of 1..2646. Does not: prove the base clauses use gv (static reading), mutate encoder B (no encoder-level negative control), check B_C311 metadata, cross-check the vars line; assumes deterministic B and the same interpreter.
control_limits.a_shape: Exact structural characterisation of the emitted A family relative to A's inverse map (588 groups x 45+360, no bad shape, no duplicates, total 238140): completeness follows because 45 and 360 are the maximal admissible key counts. Does not independently establish the semantic meaning of A's map (rests on gram_enc.build = k3_cubes.variable_map) and does not cover any CNF.
control_limits.b_coverage_positives: C1: on the 2100 disjoint local assignments with every square nonempty, exactly the 450 of type (4,1,1)/(3,2,1) are rejected; spec = template. Five classical triples give (0,0) on the cut clauses only (they violate base G4). Psi(f) gives exactly (2940,0): non-vacuity outside every triple encoding (weight 5 > (W) bound 4; the fixture is not mutually orthogonal). No genuine K3 positive exists; the controls do not test validity of the cuts, which rests on the transport lemma and G1/G2.
control_limits.c_mutations: Six concrete defect classes are caught for structural reasons (shape_ok false in the five emitted mutants; the mistransported column exclusion raises KeyError on a collinear pair). Not exhaustive; distinct_ok is count-coupled; reasons are not stored.
control_limits.d_invariance: Set invariance under the exact k3_lex.image sigma for all 22 generators and under transposition; removing one clause breaks invariance for some generator. Logically implied by the uniform definition plus (a); does not replace the mathematical argument.
control_limits.e_ab: The in-process B decode equals A's map (the only non-tautological datum; weaker than the oracle). Block-SHA and set equality are tautological given equal maps; the swapped-map SHA difference only shows SHA sensitivity. Not an independent cut implementation.
